approaches_tried.approach: Duplicate classify_occurrence logic separately in the repair engine

approaches_tried.approach: Treat multiple occurrences sharing an identical anchored span as an unresolvable overlap conflict
approaches_tried.reason: bacon_2018's own named-axiom validation target has exactly this shape (two negations in one sentence, no distinguishing word between them); added a shared-span refinement that looks for the same count of literal corruption instances inside the shared span and splits them in left-to-right order

approaches_tried.approach: Symmetric +/-12 char slack on the word-landmark gap-length estimate (inherited from Phase 1)
approaches_tried.reason: idempotence test revealed cumulative shrinkage from several nearby repairs pushed later occurrences outside a symmetric slack, causing false unanchored results on re-scan of an already-repaired file; switched to asymmetric slack_low=90/slack_high=15 (repairs only ever shrink text, never grow it)
